objectives.title: Unlock the flag
objectives.prompt: Recover the three passwords with the decryption oracle and read the flag.
hints: Each query tests a single key, unless one ciphertext can be valid under many keys at once.
Look up partitioning oracle attacks on non-committing AEAD.

steps.title: Identify the mode
steps.prompt: Which authenticated encryption mode protects the ciphertexts?

steps.title: Size the key space
steps.prompt: How many letters long is each password?

steps.title: Find the missing property
steps.prompt: Which property does the mode lack, so that one ciphertext can decrypt validly under several keys?

steps.title: Name the attack
steps.prompt: What is the attack that splits the key space with each crafted query called?
